definitions.explanation: Acting on one's own initiative or judgment without being told or forced to do so. Emphasizes willingness and self-motivation.

examples.japanese: {自主的|じしゅてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自主的|じしゅてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The students carried out cleaning activities on their own initiative.

examples.japanese: {自主的|じしゅてき}な{学|まな}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A self-directed attitude toward learning becomes important even after entering society.

notes:
USAGE:
{自主的|じしゅてき} is a na-adjective derived from ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧ (autonomy, independence) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like, -istic). Often used adverbially as {自主的|じしゅてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {自主的|じしゅてき}な + noun
- Adverb: {自主的|じしゅてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Predicate: {自主的|じしゅてき}だ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自主的|じしゅてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to act independently)
- {自主的|じしゅてき}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (independent judgment)
- {自主的|じしゅてき}な⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧ (voluntary initiative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自発的|じはつてき}→自発的：06132_jihatsuteki⟧: spontaneous, voluntary — emphasizes acting from inner impulse
- ⟦{主体的|しゅたいてき}→主体的：05749_shutaiteki⟧: proactive, taking ownership — emphasizes taking the lead role
